reason: A read-only MCP toolset for coding agents that searches a versioned library documentation catalog, lists releases, and extracts documentation snippets from local or optionally remote indexes.

summaries.zh: 为编码智能体提供基于版本的库文档目录搜索、版本查询和相关文档片段提取工具。
summaries.en: Provides coding agents with read-only tools to search a versioned library documentation catalog, inspect releases, and extract relevant documentation snippets.

capabilities: Searches a versioned library documentation catalog
Reads a local index and can optionally fetch a remote index
Exposes read-only tools through an MCP server
